[1:17PM] #TrafficUpdate #LagosBadagryExp 

Traffic is currently flowing smoothly from Agbara Customs Checkpoint through to Iyana Era. The stretch between Iyana Era and Iyana Isashi, continuing to Afromedia, remains steady with no significant delays. Conditions from Afromedia to Iyana Iba, heading inward toward Volks, are also favorable.

There is a consistent flow of traffic atop the Iyana Iba flyover toward Mile 2, as well as beneath the flyover in the direction of Igando. Movement from Volks to Barracks remains fluid, and the corridor connecting Barracks, Abule Osun, Trade Fair, and extending to Abule Ado is experiencing clear traffic conditions.

Currently, no disruptions have been reported, and traffic personnel are actively on ground to maintain order and ensure continued smooth operations.

#FollowLASTMA
